turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here? Nobody called me before my son's zero went into the gradebook.
Flattery isn't an answer. Why did Owen get a zero?
Almost unnervingly well-spoken. Every sentence perfectly built.
I argue for a living. What do you have on Owen's essay?
It's impressive. Do you ever just relax?
Not on a Tuesday with a zero on my son's record. Who made the call, Hale, and was Owen asked anything first?
